t:
Oh, it's a famous story closely tied to Irene!

The last elven kingdom used to be here. During the Cataclysm, it survived only thanks to a mysterious artifact that King Grallon kept close – the Key of Creation. The king had a daughter, young Princess Daguta who was trying to get herself a husband.

Everything was fine until a mysterious Stranger showed up at the gates, guided by his own ambitions and desires! He seduced Daguta, compelled her to steal the Key, and thus doomed them all!

King Grallon escaped with a handful of courtiers, and they watched Irene sink into the Astral. But as we know now, the allod wasn't completely destroyed \...

t:
The tradition existed before the Cataclysm.

The great feasts, where every House sought to overcome, transcend, and impress everyone.

In the beginning, the Conclave used the occasion to solve their issues. It was an honor to become a student of a Great Mage, especially the one that had lived before the Cataclysm. Soon, they began bringing other comprehensive issues to everyone's attention.

Everything was ruined after the Cataclysm. Many elves died. Those who survived under the Great Mages' protection, couldn't meet their kin from other allods.

The Irene allod survived. The last king had an artifact, the Key of Creation, given to him by the Conclave. The power of the Key was enough to support an allod.

Soon, a tragedy happened. The Key was stolen, and Irene disappeared into the astral. Grallon, the last king, used a portal to move himself and a handful of subjects to the Yoggor allod, supported by the king's distant relative, the Great Mage Gramon de Doucer.

Grallon was very old by that time. He didn't live long after that. Many claimed him as their blood relative. House de Desirae, the House of Grallon's wife, was one of them. But Gramon de Doucer took another decision. He restored the tradition of the Great Balls.

It wasn't visited much in the beginning. After a while, elves learned to create cheap and stable portals. The Great Balls attracted many participants. The old era was kicking in.

The leader was chosen in a competition. A queen's relative, the Great Mage Margo de Desirae, strongly objected. She declared herself the new queen of elves. From that moment, the House that won the Great Ball was considered the ruling House of elves.

You shall meet King Louis de Desirae, son of Margo and father of Prince Dakkar. After the victory in the year 990, House de Desirae defines the elven politics. Everything will change soon.

You need to appear before the king.
r64589.n: How did Great Balls come about?

t:
The elves are in touch with their motherland. The kingdom lost many of its subjects, but still captured imagination of every visitor. Irene was the abode of the most skilled people of craft. The goods were highly valued in all corners of the world. There's no saying about fine arts and culture! Artists, poets, sculptors, all of them created incredible masterpieces.

Several dynasties replaced one another over thousands of years. The Ollatars, the Vellunds, the Derniers, and many others.

Many elven Houses were blood relatives of the Royalty. Every House head recognized the suzerainty of the Irene kings. Many heads of Houses received noble titles as a token of appreciation of their merit to the throne. The noble titles were proudly worn by House members and passed down in generations.

t:
Weaponsmiths are always in demand: we make swords and spiked clubs, bows and crossbows, and even magic wands. But before you get down to crafting weapons, you'll have to practice making kitchen knives and simple hammers.

It is easier than it seems. Use weaponsmith's tools, learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the correct components. You can take coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore and cast in the molds you need. Parts will be harder to obtain. Rods, tips, bases, blades, braidings, additives, flux, granulations, enamels... The process is really much like a game. You make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the others. You can only reforge each part twice, and you can work on at least two parts at a time.

t:
No one but us blacksmiths can make plate armor. Also, we possess the art of forging rings. But first you'll have to practice making shields and various household implements.
Now, to the craft. Use a mobile forge to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore that should then be cast in the molds you need. As for rivets, chains, heeltaps and spikes, those can be obtained by fighting enemies.
The forging process is simple: you create five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the rest. You can only reforge each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you craft. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you. The highest available skill level in blacksmithing equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics. Also, we can create tools to work with equipment pieces and staples - you will need those at the highest development level.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while. Keep in mind, though, that retroform affects neither ore nor the goods made from it.
Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.

t: Vlad Kononov, blacksmith. Do you know what a blacksmith is? They are the embodiment of strength, agility, and dexterity! I'm telling you, I can hit even a flea! You have no idea how much armor I've made. The whole League Army wears my armor! And what are you doing here? What is it that you need?
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.

No one but us leatherworkers can craft leather outfits. Plus, we can make earrings.
Now, about the process itself. Use a leatherworker's box to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. The ropes required for your work can be bought from me. You'll get the other components by fighting enemies. Clasps, laces, fringe and insets can be used as they are. As to leather fragments, you'll have to cut them with pincers first.
The process is simple: you make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and retailor the others. You can only retailor each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you make. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will be increased and new blueprints will be available to you.
The highest available skill level in leatherworking equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow crafting items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics.
And most importantly: we can create Glyphs! Fight enemies at the Wild Shore and in the Astral to get required reagents. In order to create Glyphs of the highest quality, you will have to convert your Inspiration points into Illumination points. When the Illumination progress of a Glyph recipe reaches its maximum, you will be able to improve the quality of the produced Glyph.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use Retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while.
Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.

Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow crafting items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics.
And most importantly: we can create Glyphs! Fight enemies at the Wild Shore and in the Astral to get required reagents. In order to create Glyphs of the highest quality, you will have to convert your Inspiration points into Illumination points. When the Illumination progress of a Glyph recipe reaches its maximum, you will be able to improve the quality of the produced Glyph.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use Retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while.
Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
r74317.n: Learn how to become a leatherworker

t:
The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
First of all, work on improving your tools. This will allow you to get rid of faulty parts, reforge one part at a time, increase the maximum number of reforges to three, and even stimulate your inspiration. With your tools improved, half of the parts you make will be uncommon, a third will be rare, and only one-sixth of them will be epic. Upgrades can be bought from me.
If you got away with a smaller number of retailoring attempts, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try and make epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every craftsman decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.
r74318.n: Ask about tips for experienced leatherworkers

t: Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
My name is Karim Shagrenin and I'm a master leatherworker. I have traveled here from Suslanger to share my knowledge. Do you have any questions for me?
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.

No one but us tailors can craft clothes from fabric or make cloaks. Besides, we possess the knowledge how to make necklaces.
Now, about the process itself. Use a sewing kit to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. The threads required for your work can be bought from me. You'll get the other components by fighting enemies. Embroidery, lace, buttons and beads can be used as they are, while fabric rolls have to be cut with scissors first.
The process is simple: you make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and retailor the others. You can only retailor each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you make. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you.
The maximum available level of tailoring equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics.
By the way, if you ever need lower-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while.
Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
r74453.n: Learn how to become a tailor

t: I'm Yana Beketova, a fourth generation tailor. Nezeb himself wore clothes that were made by my great grandmother! So, how can I help you?

An occasional failure is inevitable, everybody knows that. Make sure to use the correct ingredients, the properties of which will result in something useful. It's doubtlessly more rewarding to brew something good than just a portion of goo. Besides, even if you can't use it yourself, you can always sell it at an auction, eysh!

Remember to use only tools of the highest available quality. Pick up right herbs, and with a little luck, you might brew two different potions at once!

Use a herb as described in a recipe. If you ever see an unknown property, don't let it scare you off - it will surely work for the future!

r74514.n: Exchange Alchemical Absorbent for 2 Mandrake Roots

r74520.n: Exchange Flora Distorter for 2 Mandrake Roots

r74521.n: Exchange 10 Flora Distorters for 20 Mandrake Roots

t: What do you need so much suspension for? Are you drinking it, or what? Alright, take it, before I change my mind!
My name is Sarbaz Losash. I started studying alchemy a very long time ago, all the way back in my past life. I can tell you anything you need to know on the subject.

After using the alchemic mortar, place the following ingredients inside: herbs with the required properties and auxiliary substances that you can buy from me.
The properties of the ingredients used must form a harmonious combination. If you can ensure that, you'll get a potion whose effect depends directly on how well-matched the properties are. Yet the brewing process can result in a failure. You need to be ready for that and not lose hope.
By increasing your skill level, you'll gain access to new, more sophisticated and powerful formulas. Try making exactly these potions: the more sophisticated the formula, the greater the increase in your skill. However, making potions of levels surpassed long ago won't help your development. Your skill level depends on your character level as well: you can't become a high-class master if you stop developing.

An occasional failure is inevitable, everybody knows that. Make sure to use the correct ingredients, the properties of which will result in something useful. It’s doubtlessly more rewarding to brew something good than just a portion of goo. Besides, even if you can’t use it yourself, you can always sell it at an auction!
Remember to use only high quality equipment. Upgrade it whenever possible. This will enable you to brew over one potion at one attempt. Pick up right herbs, and with a little luck, you might brew two different potions at once!
Use a herb as described in a recipe. If you ever see an unknown property, don’t let it scare you off - it will surely work for the future!
Sivoyar Zablosky, teacher of alchemy, at your service. I am here to use my expertise for the glory of Novograd! How can I help?
Here it is, your future ship!
Congratulations! Your ship is finished. It's now ready to travel the Astral.

Your ship is coming along nicely.

I'm sure you'll be very pleased when it's finished!
r74755.n: Ask about your ship's construction progress

t: What do you want to know?
Remember that while the repairs are being completed you can't take your ship out of the hangar. You can cancel the repairs at any time, but all materials that were spent will be lost.
The repairs are completed. Your ship is ready to travel once again.
We're repairing your ship as fast as possible. You can cancel the repairs at any time, but all materials that have already been spent will be lost.
r74759.n: Ask about your ship's repair progress

t:
Damaged ships should be repaired after returning to the hangar. I can help you with this process, but you will need to bring me the proper materials before it can begin.
The repair process can take some time. The duration depends on the extent of the damage. However, the repair process can be accelerated by completing special tasks. You can check on the progress that's been made by talking to me at any time! I'll be happy to keep you updated.
The repair process ends automatically if you depart to the Astral. And if the ship has been repaired to full, you can simply summon it and proceed with your travels.
Your ship has been removed from the hangar.
Are you sure you want to unsummon your ship? All treasures that remain on it will be lost.
Alright, your ship's devices are no longer being changed. The ship is now ready to travel!

You can now change your ship's devices.

When you're on board, select the device you want to change and select the replacing one.

In this mode, your ship will not operate and all other devices will be disabled. Don't forget to turn it off before you depart.
Ready! Next time that you summon your ship, you will be able to rename it!

Do you want to rename your ship? Not a problem!

But there will be a lot of paperwork, and it will cost you. You can do it only once a day!

And of course, you will have to summon the ship.
Welcome to the Astral hangar! What can I help you with?
Welcome to the Astral hangar! What can we help you with?
Aw, stop shouting! ‘S all gonna be done, not to worry.
r75002.n: Aw, stop shouting! ‘S all gonna be done, not to worry.

t: Aaah! Gorluxor is alive! Alive! He will be here soon! He is going to kill Soliskar, who is supporting the allods from being swallowed by the Astral and rules the draconids... Oh, it hurts!
Fly, little bird! Come back quickly!
r75731.n: Fly, little bird! Come back quickly!

t:
Oh, even I can manage this much!
Go!
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
With a squeak and a hissing, the engine starts up. Great!
r76465.n: Place a battery on the barge

t: It's useless. The barge has no reactor, and the battery has a low charge.
This barge is in a miserable state, however, there's no other suitable item.
r76467.n: This barge is in a miserable state, however, there's no other suitable…

t: Perfect! I'll make arrangements to start the construction right away. It's quite a long process, but I can tell you how to speed it up.

r76516.n: We finally finished the job! You are now the proud owner of an Astral ship.

t:
We’re approaching the wormhole to the very sector. No rescue from demons...

Demons! Demons attack!

Damn them, now we have to make a blind jump again. Light save us...

What are you looking at? Hurry to the cannon, shoot them, shoot! We need to break through to the wormhole!
How do you feel? Dizzy? Do you see multi-colored spots?
r78013.n: How do you feel? Dizzy? Do you see multi-colored spots?

t: Thank you! You saved my life!
r78179.n: Thank you! You saved my life!

t: Go forth and do not be afraid, my child.
I can deliver you from your fear, but it will cost you some drops of mirra. Do you want to proceed?
r78969.n: Ask about the Fear of Death

t: I can deliver you from your fear, but it will cost you some drops of mirra. Unfortunately, you don't have enough right now.
r78970.n: Ask about the Fear of Death

t: It is not that easy! You cannot walk or ride there. I will teach you a spell, which will teleport you directly to the Kingdom of Nature at any moment you like.
r79494.n: Ask how to get to the Kingdom of Elements

t: Is it starting already? Ay-hya! I'm on my way!

You want to make a cape of white fur, zoor? But there are no white-furred animals around here. I know these cliffs better than anyone!

But I know someone who has fur like that. The creatures from the League! I heard Dool the Cuckoo calling them the Gibberlings. I bet these are their hairs, eysh!

The furry fellows always walk in threes. I think they are trrading something with Dool the Cuckoo... Dool is one sly hunhurr! Ask him, what is it they trrade with the Gibberlings? I want to trade, too!
Aho, kinsman. I'm Aata. What is your name? Do you have the second name yet? I can't wait to get rid of my childish name!
r80065.n: Aho, kinsman. I'm Aata. What is your name? Do you have the second name…

t:
I've found your flask. Propagandina has confiscated it due to our antialcoholism program.

Confiscating flasks is not our method. We pursue cultural education!

Return the missing flask to the Gibberlings and tell them about the Imperial art! Explain to them that cinema is the future!
How did you like the cinema? Do you feel inspired and proud for the Empire? No? Huh. You must be too uncivilized for it. Sorry, no offence meant!
r80108.n: How did you like the cinema? Do you feel inspired and proud for the…

t:
Hey, I'm not lost! I'd never get... Hic! Who's drunk? Me?! No way! I'm just strolling about, smelling the flowers, writing poems...

You see, I just didn't want to go back on my own... I mean, without a company. You are a good company! Please, come with me, I'm scared...
r80245.n: Tell Elrick his sisters are looking for him

t: Errr... Are you going to eat me? Hic!
r80246.n: Errr... Are you going to eat me? Hic!

t: Alright, alright! I know that we are guests here, and we ain't supposed to fight. If he calms down, I will stand back.

That Xadaganian was the first one to pick on me, hey! He decries my church and offends me!

I'm not gonna kill him, just beat him up a little! If he wants to settle this, then he owes me an apology!

This mug thinks that their Nezeb and Skrakan are just as sacred as Tensess himself! What a nonsense!

Nezeb and Skrakan were heroes who gave their lives to fight Demons and saved us all, but the Light was only given by Tensess, and everyone else must worship him. This is the teaching of our church - Tensess brought the Light to people in the dark years to save them from dying and hurting, and to give them strength to fight Demons. And so we did!
r80627.n: Ask about the origin of the quarrel

t: What do you want? You better help me punch that brat in the face! He dares to defile the pictures of Holy Tensess, huh!
r80628.n: What do you want? You better help me punch that brat in the face! He…

t:
Yes, right... That would be really foolish if I was sent back to Nezebgrad because of a fight.

Alright, tell that bearded mug that I overreacted. We will discuss it later... Away from prying eyes!
Calm down?! I am as calm as a dead goblin! I will calmly tell that unshaved mug what our postulates are all about!

This blatant mule won't accept the sanctity of Nezeb and Skrakan!

Holy Tensess, Nezeb, and Skrakan were the ones who gave life to the world. Yes, Tensess was the first one to give the Light to people, but it doesn't lessen the merits of great Nezeb and wise Skrakan, who brought the Light to all mortals and gave up their lives in battle with Demons!

The Trinity Church worships them equally, and those retrogrades of the Holy Church are merely renegades and charlatans!
r80664.n: Ask about the origin of the quarrel

t: Step back! We have some ideological disagreements here! Either this Kanian drunkard will accept the truth, or I will break his jaw!
r80665.n: Step back! We have some ideological disagreements here! Either this…

t:
I see no fear in your eyes, strange cub. You can become a hunter... if you survive.

Look, here goes Scar, your enemy. Look into his eyes, cub. If I smell fear in you, I will renounce you, and nothing will save you from prey's fate!

Scar is a dangerous enemy. Sooner or later he will find you, whether the Pack will accept you or not. Maybe you shouldn't put off the inevitable? Surrender now, and maybe the tiger will have mercy and kill you quickly.

No? You are clinging to your life till the last, I like that. Maybe you'll amount to something one day. I will speak my word in your defense.

But even if Akkya accepts you, Scar won't let it go. Come to me after the Council, I will teach you how to fight. Then, maybe, you will live to see another moon.
You are alien to this forest, cub. What do you want?
r80837.n: You are alien to this forest, cub. What do you want?

t:
The Pack has already gone to follow the trail of the prey, and only the young cubs are left behind. I want you to lead them on a trail of a deer. You need to learn how to hunt together and act as a whole, because you are - the Pack!

Talk to your brothers. The elder hunters will drive the deer right at you, and then you will have to drive it to the Council Rock. Being a beater is a great honor!

The brothers have agreed to follow you? Well done, cub!

A big and strong deer lives in the Thicket. You will track him down and drive him to the Council Rock. I will finish him here. Akkya never fails!

Are you speaking about Scar? Rawr! The wicked cat deserves a good thrashing. I think that scoundrel killed our babies, but wolves stand no chance against a tiger.

Wait... I can smell him!
I will tear you, you slug!
Leave the dummies for the youngsters, kylys. If you want to prove that you can fight, fight with me.
r81371.n: Leave the dummies for the youngsters, kylys. If you want to prove that…

t: Remember: your faith is the key to victory!

Up until you reach level 60, you can reset your stats for free, so don't hesitate to experiment!
Starting from level 61, you will need to bring me Water of Life to reset your stats. You can get it in the Boutique.
You can also opt to use Water of Life Droplets that allow resetting stats an indefinite number of times during 2 days.
Finally, if you manage to get yourself a Vial of Condensed Water of Life, you will be able to reset your stats whenever you want.
r81438.n: How can I reset my stats?

t:
Up until you reach level 60, you can reset your talents for free, so don't hesitate to experiment!
Starting from level 61, you will need to bring me Water of Death to reset your talents. You can get it in the Boutique.
You can also opt to use Water of Death Droplets that allow resetting talents an indefinite number of times during 2 days.
Finally, if you manage to get yourself a Vial of Condensed Water of Death, you will be able to reset your talents whenever you want.
r81439.n: How can I reset my talents?

t:
Darkness! Darkness! DARKNESS!!! Death! Everything is on fire! This is the end! We are doomed! There’s no escape, darkness can’t be stopped!!

Ugh... I think it was a nightmare...
Oh... Yes... Need to go back... How did I end up here, anyway?
r82065.n: Wake up already! It was a nightmare.

t: Dream... just a dream... Good... Need to get back. Where it’s safe.
r82098.n: It’s alright, the nightmare is over.

t:
His wrath is terrifying! There’s no escape. The dark wave is higher than the city walls, higher than the mountains! Why didn’t you listen? Everything... is dead.

Aah...! It’s a dream, just a dream...

Hello! And who are you?

You’re looking for Ademar? Yes, he’s been here for a while. I look after him - feed him and everything, but nothing works.

His heart and soul are shrouded in sorrow ever since his daughter Annette went missing. I don’t know what to do, I’ve tried everything. There’s only one option left, but it’s not something I can do myself.

Are you a great hero? Will you help, then? Go to White Lake, speak with the Bird Oracle Gamayun. Do what it says, and you might be able to help Ademar.
Looks like there's a trinket-shaped cut in the bark.
r82248.n: Looks like there's a trinket-shaped cut in the bark.

t: Let’s hope fish is hungry and likes the berries. You wouldn’t want it to snack on you, would you?
r82358.n: Let’s hope fish is hungry and likes the berries. You wouldn’t want it…

t: Demons? What demons? As if the Leper was not enough! Where have the demons come from? Go talk to Ratmir, let him explain!
You can hear distant sounds of carriage wheels, steps, hooves, and feel the smell of campfire and herbs...

Going by the diary, the grain of Protopower is in the secret chamber, which we can enter through a passage. The door to this passage is... let me see... right here, in the library! Let’s search the room.
Zayan’s diary goes about the grain of Protopower - an item of huge might, that grants power over elementals. Where could it be hidden?
r83247.n: Zayan’s diary goes about the grain of Protopower - an item of huge…

t:
What is this? Do you have any idea of what this is? Careful! If you drop it, as much as a hole in the ground will remain instead of the tower!

Elementals? What elementals? Ah, the ones on the roof! They’re easy, just direct the Grain’s power on them, and they’re done.

For the sake of the Astral, go and get the Sphere! And don’t you touch anything else, hear me?
r84028.n: Ask about the Grain of Protopower

t: Where do you want to go?
r84538.n: Where do you want to go?

t:
Portals allow you to instantly teleport between different parts of Sarnaut. It's one of the most convenient ways to travel between parts of this broken world. Astral ships are frequently used to transport goods and larger groups of people, but portals are the method of choice for individual travelers.
In order to use a portal you must have already visited your destination point. You need to be imprinted with the portal's magical energy before you can teleport there or you might not come out in one piece! Talk to the Portal Keeper as soon as you discover a new portal.
Good luck and happy travels!

I can help you learn more about this land through a series of educational tasks. You can also help us Anthropologists with our own research! If you complete all my assignments, I promise you'll be generously rewarded.
I've heard some explorers complained that our tasks are too difficult. Well, why don't we compromise? I will sell you trophies and valuable resources required to complete two tasks.
You can help our research in whatever way you like.
r84609.n: I can help you learn more about this land through a series of…

t:
In the beginning of this eon, the universe was empty. The last eon ended with a terrible war that devastated the universe.

But there was a great Eidos, home of all the gods. It was the beginning of everything. Everything that had to be created originally existed in Eidos.

And although the gods were at enmity with each other, peace reigned in Eidos, maintained by the royal couple - Father Time and All-Mother. Infinitely wise and capable, they were determined to rebuild existence.

At the very beginning, twelve inner worlds were created...

There are no heroes without victory over monsters, but monsters also need worlds that spawn them.

Sherk is a world of endless swamps where everything is mixed together. This world was extremely dangerous for anyone who dared to travel here. Endless struggle is the true state of the inhabitants of Sherk.

Bearing the same name, its deity was a giant monster which slept in the depths of the local warm and muddy ocean. Its children, left unattended, kept trying to reach other worlds.

But they were closely watched at the time.

This world was the source of every precious metal and stone the gods needed. In their desire to improve the universe, they descended into vast caves full of gems and dug passages in the depths.

Then it turned out that the surface of Erde was also rich - gardens were planted here, blooming and fragrant.
Here it is. Please, don't lose it again. This stone is a sign of great trust. Only those who have completed the Path of Revelations are granted one. You'd be wise to guard it well.
The stone I'm about to give you will teleport you to the grates. These are invisible passageways underneath Gipat. You can use them to travel faster around the world.
r85567.n: The stone I'm about to give you will teleport you to the grates. These…

t: As soon as you repeat all of Ath-Zak's feats and bring six Signs of the Chosen One to me, I will allow you access to the mysteries that lay to the north. Until then, I advise you to stay away from that area. Going there will only bring you certain death...
r85594.n: Ask about the Path of the Chosen One

t: Your attention, please! Those Chosen Ones who are allowed to follow the Cursed Path are required to talk to Delmon de Blizare! Laure de Grandeur is looking for the Chosen Ones of the League, and Viktor Tverdolobin is looking for the Chosen Ones of the Empire! Please go to them before you set out on your journey!

r85596.n: Go to the Isle of Intrusion

t:
What? The cultist was castrated? Turn around, let me check... Oh, bloody hell! What a terrible joke that was! Although, he is a pretty worthless loser. It probably wouldn't make much of a difference. If I were him, I'd probably join a cult as well... A cult of girls!
I'm not going to be a part of this! Damn everything! Change everything back the way it was! I'd rather be a ghost of a hero than a live as the village clown...

That'll be easy! What a brilliant idea! We can't do anything to him until we combine our souls, and then I'll be able to drag all the names out of him. I'll be able to find out the names of all his cousins if I want!
Now, why are you looking at me like that? Are you up to something? You're not planning to lure me out so he can possess my body, do you? Not bloody likely, good sir. I'm not a simpleton!
r86431.n: Ask to question the cultist's soul

t:
What do you expect will come of this? It's not a big deal to spend half the day in the bushes. We're quite used to that. You just have to find a place with a lot of leaves.
As for my liver, I'll just jump off the allod. Death can cure illnesses, you know. The higher you jump, the quicker suffering ends!
r86432.n: Ask about the bodie's poor health

t:
Hah! What do you expect me to do? I don't care if they chose a cherry tree as their leader! Let them worship a tea cup or dragon droppings! I don't give a damn!
Sorry but I can't turn into a ghost again. The mere thought of it makes my stomach turn. Surely there must be another way to find out this name.
r86433.n: Tell him about the cultist's proposal

t: This body is pretty weak and skeleton-like. Couldn't you do any better than this?! Oh well. I'm going to get drunk and pick up a few female Chosen Ones. Hopefully one day I'll learn to look at my reflection without disgust.
r86434.n: This body is pretty weak and skeleton-like. Couldn't you do any better…

r86448.n: I've lost the jar with Osip's spark.

t:
Orcs? Those bastards? How could they have caught us unaware? It probably happened after we bid farewell to Ath-Zak, so that he could continue his journey. I drank too much that evening and I can't remember what's happened since then. That's when I must've been killed. How unfair! I can't even remember my last fight...
While Ath-Zak and I were wandering across Gipat we talked a lot, you know. He said something about repressed memories! He had lost his memory then too. Maybe I'll remember everything over time just like he did.

So that's how things went... Orcs destroyed the entire village, didn't they? Yes, it was as soon as Ath-Zak left. It's all because I, the militia's commander, was already dead. The barbarians must have grown bolder. They wouldn't have dared to attack the village if I were alive.

What? I don't want to talk to anyone... Leave me alone, leave me alone! No, wait... Tell me if the elder or anyone else said anything about me. Do they want to throw me out of the village? No?
Oh, I'd be better off dead! I can't remember anything! Can you hear me? Nothing! I can't recall that fight with Ath-Zak either! Don't you dare forget that! Oh, oh, oh...

r86560.n: I am ready to move out.

t: The Show Stele is guarded by me and maintains the integrity of the Show. Only the one who defeats me may approach it. The weak shall perish. I don't care about anything else.
r86616.n: I came here to destroy the source of the Show’s power.

r86729.n: I am ready to begin the ritual.

t: Oh, the trials life throws at us!
r86731.n: Oh, the trials life throws at us!

t:
[You open the bookmarked page]:

Witches can trick human senses and keep things hidden from them. But someone with a pure soul can fight the illusion - if the witch herself is not around, the illusion can be projected by some other enchanted objects hidden nearby. It can be:

1) Bones of various small animals.

2) Amulets.

3) Figures made of wood or other materials.

4) Bodies and body parts of various vermin like frogs, snakes, gnats, or lizards.

5) Gifts of nature: gemstones, minerals and other objects of value.
You need to find and break these items for the illusion to dissipate.

[This information might be useful!]

[You open a random page]:

Contrary to popular belief, not all spells utilize dark magic.

Sorcerers know how to influence the flow of humors in a way that heals the patient. Moreover, these methods can cure ailments of the body and mind and rarely have negative consequences, which cannot be said about medicine.

Witches harness this power from nature itself, acting in accordance with its laws that are unknown to those not privy to this knowledge.

[The book is fairly damaged but you can make out a fragment on a random page]:

An hour later, he was approached by two members of the city council and put under arrest as a sorcerer. They were going to take him to the district head or a judge. When the judge noticed his approach from afar, he gave the order to imprison the "sorcerer" for life without even letting him speak. For three days, the man begged the jailers to explain why he was being treated like this, because he had not done anything wrong.

[You read random anecdotes]:

A mage and a scholar visit an exhibition of boring pretentious bore, and the witch at the entrance says, "Sorry, but you can't bring your own!"

"Hey, can you take a look at my back?"

"Revered sorcerer, there's a stake in your back! It must hurt like hell!"

"No... Only when I laugh..."

I'm from a very respectable family. Father is Scholar, mother is Artist, and my sister is Mage. They got these nicknames on their first sabbath.
You see a bookcase full of semi-prohibited works. What should I read...
r86786.n: You see a bookcase full of semi-prohibited works. What should I read...

t:
[The note you are reading is dated yesterday]:

Finally! I begged and begged for years, but the old hag wouldn't be fooled. She finally deemed me worthy of becoming her apprentice. And it's real magic, not some tricks! With her powers, I won't have to pretend to be some "wise woman" anymore and heal local cretins, praying that no one decides they want to burn me at the stake...

She is hiding in Foul Dale, near the hunters' camp. I know that place, I'm leaving everything and going there tonight...

[You leaf through the book and find many interesting notes]:

Witches. They say witchcraft comes from the darkness of time... The first sorcerers were trained by the Elven Conclave which established the rules and regulations of magic. But there were those who ignored all rules and regulations. Their names are hidden and all but forgotten, but there are legends of the Raven Queen and the leader of the Wild Horde.

They were banished by the Conclave, but not all knowledge can be crossed out. Those who sought power ignored all rules and found the hidden books. That was how witchcraft was born. Dark, evil magic, it absorbed the legacy of Zem and Aro tribes. Then the June blood magic, shamanism, and the folk magic traditions of small nations.

Umoir witches are a special case. There have always been dense forests and abandoned villages where anyone can take refuge. It's no surprise there were so many of them here. But they came into power only after the fall of Veligrad. When Leviathan razed the city, Skrakan's artifact storage was also destroyed. The witches gained a lot of power in those ruins.

Whatever they are hiding must be very interesting. Who knows what they stole?
[You leaf through the book. There are clearly more pages than there should be, and they turn at the lightest touch. You see descriptions of various days, rituals, and spells...]
r86814.n: [You leaf through the book. There are clearly more pages than there…

t:
Oh, my... Dangerous business. Every rat knows me in there! And that loud-mouth Grot is too much!

Well fine, I’ll tighten my helmet over my ears, so no one recognizes me. Those psychos with antennae on their heads will definitely detect who I am!

Oh no.

But Kork promised to help, right? The captain’s word... I mean the ordinary goblin Kork's word is like steel! So!

I’m ready!
r87237.n: Investigate the Situation in the Outpost

t: Personal business, eh... Fine, go ahead. I don’t want to get a beating from him.
r87242.n: I’m on personal business from Captain Grot!

t: First catch some prey! Don’ be lazy!
Enough of that! Stop distracting me! Or I'm gonna hit you!
Like you don't know. None of your business.
r87261.n: Where did the money come from?

t:
On women and booze, of course! Caligula has the hottest girls! Time to visit Skewer!

It will be done soon. Grot will be pleased, and the order will be fulfilled.
r87264.n: Same! I can't decide what to spend it on.

r87266.n: Have you ever jumped from here?

t: Enough! We've been here for so long, and I have to cook for you idiots!
r87273.n: Does he owe you a lot? When will he pay?

t: Have you been chewing on the local mushrooms? Grot will rip you apart and feed you to his beasts. Get out of here, instigator!
No... They are loyal to Grot, because he pays well, and this is a big order. It won't work! Now get out of here before they hang us!
Riot, you say? Who's with us?
r87276.n: Let's riot! Yeah, I don't like this situation.

t: I don't, but if I did, I wouldn't tell you. What if you're working for the competition, trying to steal our order? Go away, eavesdropper!
r87277.n: Do you know who the customer is?

t:
That guy? Pfft... No, there's a bigger fish. Grot went pale in the face when he mentioned that one. He's not afraid of the goblin.

Listen... I've had enough of this talk! Others will come begging for food now! And you're in the way, so get out.
r87278.n: I heard Caligula, the owner of the Skewer island, holds animal fights!

t: Take a guess. He got a rich customer...
r87279.n: Take a guess. He got a rich customer...

t: Yes, but he still owes me some!
r87280.n: Listen... Has Grot paid you yet?

t: Hey, did you make it all up? The debt? So you could pit us against each other? I'll show you!
r87281.n: Why don't you just poison us?

t: It's Grunt. Maybe you should ask him about the debt? Just start with a code phrase: "Evil maiden sank to the bottom"! Don't forget.
r87282.n: Who keeps track of our gambling debts?

t: That bastard! Maybe I should add pepper to his food. He's lying, that dog!
r87283.n: I don’t know, he said that...

t: I'm going to hit you so you leave me alone!
r87284.n: Are you going to pay or not?

t: Huh, that bastard. Made up a story about debt thinking he could fool everyone!
r87286.n: He said he'd complain to the captain!

t: Money? How about I give you this!
r87287.n: Proof, right... Give me the money!

t: What?! I owe him? Why would he think so? What's your proof?
r87288.n: The boatswain also says you owe him a debt, so I'll take the money now.

t: Go away! Get in line, you all!
r87289.n: Let me have some! My stomach is growling!

t: You? Who are you? Get out!
Debts? Let's see, let's see... He doesn't owe anyone anything.
r87297.n: Stinky Zho asks about his debts!

t: So mistrustful. But oh well. I only heard half of it when the captain was speaking to him... to her, I mean. Our customer is Victoria Korleone, the head of the drug mafia that ate up all competition on Igsh, Suslanger, and Yakhch! She deals in psi-salt, which sells well these days. Quite a terrifying lady, worse than Tep, they say! But she keeps her word, so tell him not to worry, he'll be paid.
r87298.n: He needs guarantees, because no one on the team knows who that guy is...

t: Is he an idiot? People like that aren't cheap - it's not some Izune bandit!
r87300.n: Zho is afraid the customer will dupe us!

t: Let him come, then. Why are you here? Are you an idiot? Here!
r87301.n: Stinky Zho demands to get paid right now!

t: The rest? We'll be paid when we're done with the job. Like he doesn't know. What has he been eating in his kitchen? Mushrooms?
r87302.n: Stinky Zho wants to know when the rest will be paid!

t:
I'm quite useful! I know a lot, and I can do a lot! I'll tell you everything!

Don't hit me!

My dear friends!

I'm thankful for your response and I'd like to tell you this.

I've been informed that Gala de Delice is about to start negotiations with House de Doucer in the near future. It's about amnesty and dropping all charges. House de Doucer will be given an opportunity to return to the elven society as one of the minor Houses.

We can't let that happen! We must disrupt these negotiations. Alas, Catherina decides what I'm allowed to do here in Clear Valley, but perhaps I can convince her. Our chances will be higher if you prove that the vampires can't be trusted.

Thank you for everything you do!
r87896.n: My dear friends! I'm thankful for your response and I'd like to tell…

t:
As for the politics, things are bad in our homeland. The old Kania is gone, the soul of the nation is nobility. Foreigners control everything. Foreigners and rabble. There's no order, just endless disquiet.

Instead of investigating conspiracies of elves and Gibberlings, the authorities are persecuting old dynasties!

Have you heard the news? We are allied with demons now! Demons! It's not something our forefathers could have foreseen. Shame!
r87908.n: As for the politics, things are bad in our homeland. The old Kania is…

t:
[The vampire's stare is hungry]

I just want to go home and never see this place again.

I promise I won't touch anyone if you let me out...
r87935.n: If I let you go, are you going to hurt someone?

t: Her goal is noble but very difficult to achieve. We stopped attacking humans but it wasn't enough... Humans should stop attacking us.
r87936.n: Gala de Delice wants you and Clear Valley to coexist peacefully.

t: I swore never to drink human blood... Our house swore this oath. We have subsisted on animal blood for a long time, but these humans... They left me no choice.

I was captured in the forest when I was hunting. These humans... They locked me in this foul cage... starved me... They were about to hand me over to the mob... I wanted to kill them as soon as they opened the cage... Despite my oath...
r87938.n: Who are you? What are you doing here?

t: Leave me... or I'll kill you...
r87939.n: Leave me... or I'll kill you...

t:
Svetlana...?

You must be joking... hiccup? Don't you know Svetlana has been dead for a while?

It happened a long time ago. The old king was still alive, and he had a beautiful daughter. The Valir dynasty ruled from their castle. One day a prince visited us, a noble elf!

We marveled at him, and most of all, Svetlana herself. She fell in love, and it looked like he returned her feelings. They got married here, in the church. But then the prince left for the Ball where all elven families gathered. He was skilled in dark sorcery, and he wanted to prove himself.

He did. But he didn't know a tragedy was about to strike. When he returned to the Castle, his fiancée was lying dead in a coffin. We cried all our eyes out. The prince's face darkened, he locked the doors and started using his forbidden magic. He wanted to bring Svetlana back.

But it didn't work. As soon as the sun was down, a wind rose and blew out all candles in the castle. Screams followed - the dead started breaking out of their graves, eating the servants alive! Everyone fled in terror, trying to get away as far as they could. So did I... though I wish I'd died there.

I'm here now, living out the rest of my life...
r88007.n: Svetlana...? You must be joking... hiccup? Don't you know Svetlana has…

t: Ah, this? It's... my mother's. Or rather, grandmother's. I inherited it. Lovely, isn't it?
Stolen, you say? Well, it serves him right. Doing business with bloodsuckers, bringing disgrace on our village. I haven't seen any amulets.
r88119.n: Have you seen an enchanted amulet anywhere? It was stolen from Jade Gloom.

t: It's to protect myself... hiccup...! against bloodsuckers. They don't like hops in blood, so they won't bite me. It definitely works on gnats so it should work on ghouls, too.
I need to get back to... hiccup...! work.
r88125.n: I need to get back to... hiccup...! work.

t: What do you mean, what? The wine! Look, there's one bottle left. How else would we drown our sorrows?

Who knows? People are like sheep - they do what they are told. Perhaps one of the nobles said something about Gala and the vamps, and they got spooked.

And who suffers the most? Me! Look what they did to my cart!
r88152.n: Maybe you know why the locals suddenly hate Gala and her elves?

t: Alright, guys! Hold the elf while I show this fool...
r88201.n: Alright, guys! Hold the elf while I show this fool...

t: Who are you to tell us what to do? Get out of here!
Oh you knife-eared vermin! We'll show you!
r88249.n: Walk away now! Or I'll give you something to cry about!

t: Want to give this one a beating, too?
r88250.n: Want to give this one a beating, too?

t: We'll show you an artist, a knife-eared sympathizer!
So you're with them? We'll deal with you next!
Who are you? I don't know you.
r88256.n: Who are you? I don't know you.

t: It's not easy to offend the lot of them! Just look at their faces! They do a lot of that themselves. We didn't do anything. And we don't need to justify ourselves!
r88295.n: Have you done something to offend the locals?

t:
What, you don't remember the incredibly talented, beautiful and charming artist who painted pictures on Gipat?

It's been years! But I'm still an artist. It's all I ever dream about! Here on Umoir I found my inspiration again. I want to picture these lands in all their wild glory!

Alas, I'm always busy. I'm on an important mission from my mother, a Great Mage and the head of my House - Antoinette de Delice. I can't let her down.

And now this...
r88296.n: Who are you? Why are you here?

t: Ah, no. We have a good reason to be here, and we won't let them scare us away. I'm not moving from this spot until they leave.

Don't you know me? I'm the famous scholar Alfred de Delice. Perhaps you read my monograph on the Siverian undead? I carried out research for a few years in this cold land. My apprentice Christina helped me.

Perhaps academic science was far from the forefront of your mind these past few years, which is understandable.

I'm carrying out two important missions here. One from Zayan himself... We'll talk about it later. The second one is about the affairs of my House. I can't talk about that one, I'm sorry. But as you can see, we're trying to begin our work... It's strange. I've dealt with the Kanians and Gibberlings before, but I've never faced such attitude.

And now I'm forced to endure... this.
r88340.n: Tell me about yourself. Who are you?
